Title: Custom roles for app registration management

Body.Content:
Gain fine-grained control over what access your admins have. You can now create a role to assign permissions for managing app registrations. Custom RBAC roles for Azure AD surfaces the underlying permissions of built-in admin roles, so you can create and organize your own custom roles.

Learn more
